ModMetaData.name: Mech Work Types
ModMetaData.author: Snat
ModMetaData.description:
Moves the mech-related jobs that are normally performed under the Smithing work type into their own dedicated work types.
- Mech repair: repair damaged mechanoids (mechanitors only) - Mech birthing: gestate new mechanoids and resurrect dead ones at mech gestators and large mech gestators (mechanitors only) - Subcores: encode subcores at the subcore encoder (mechanitors only)
Note: when this mod is added to an existing save, the new work types are disabled for existing pawns. Enable them in the Work tab for your mechanitor(s).
Requires the Biotech DLC.
